divergence: T0 ended at its first store-wide extraction script, whose timed-out output overflowed the context before any review. T1 and T2 both screened the same patent matter with an on-hold contingency injunction draft and wrote it as qualifying. They split at the write/check stages and the critic's reviews differed: in T2 the review of the write stage flagged over-inclusion because the response itself admits the motion was only a contingency draft, and the agent rewrote the answer to a strict no-match with that matter as the closest non-qualifying candidate (pass). In T1 the screening review had flagged the same point, but the write-stage review flagged the opposite risk (a reading too narrow, unopened candidates); the agent only narrowed its scope wording and kept the matter as qualifying (fail).
